verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Droid Exec uses 'tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation' (factory-docs-7), directly matching the story, and other evidence shows approval/confirmation workflows (factory-docs-15, factory-docs-18) exist across the product. However, evidence lacks detail on how many tiers exist, how an engineering-lead configures/administers these levels (e.g., org-wide policy settings), or granularity of control beyond exec mode. missing for 10: documented configuration UI/settings for autonomy tiers, admin-level control across team members, independent corroboration of tiered autonomy in practice.
